annotations.title: Money markets: repo, money funds and dealers

description: The US money markets' plumbing, no key: overnight repo by segment (SOFR, TGCR, BGCR, tri-party without the Fed, GCF, cleared bilateral DVP), each rate with its volume and its spread to the Fed's interest on reserves and overnight reverse repo rate; what US money market funds hold by type and whom their repo is with (Form N-MFP, via the OFR); and primary dealers' net Treasury positions by maturity (New York Fed). part gives one with its history.

part.description: One part with its history: repo (each segment's rate and volume day by day, against the Fed's rates), money_funds (what US money market funds hold, month by month) or dealers (primary dealers' net Treasury positions, week by week). Default: all three, latest.

periods.description: part: observations shown, latest last; default 20 for repo, 13 for money_funds and dealers.

name: money_markets

outputSchema.description: repo, money_funds and dealers each hold their latest table; with part, that part's table is at the top level with its history.

title: Money markets: repo, money funds and dealers
